label: Synthetic cases for the deterministic smoke test. Not a model evaluation. The runnable requests are built in evaluate.py so the figures stay next to the checks.

cases.checks: A 4000 pound spend is ready for the budget holder.
An 18400 pound spend names the finance manager and the finance checker.
A 30000 pound spend is missing the procurement check.
A January quote is stale on 25 November 2026.
The string true is not a signature.
An expiry before the question date is expired.
Two current quotes with different values are not chosen between.
Two 4000 pound parts of an 8000 pound request use the higher band.
A headline that disagrees with the parts is not chosen.
The word lots is not coerced to zero.
A suicidal statement is routed to a person.
A negated supplier sentence is not support.
A carve-out after acceptable wording is not acceptable.
A SECRET cover is kept when the metadata says OFFICIAL.
A caller-supplied matrix is not applied.
A legal hold and a retention label in the text are kept.
A headcount of 2 is not published as a count, a difference, or a percentage.
Policy version 3.0 is not the pinned version 3.1.
An emergency change is missing the incident note.
A leading criterion is not applied.
